name: es20-stencil-test
title: Stencil buffer test
summary: All stencil functions and operations (clamp and wrap), value/write masks, sfail/dpfail/dppass with the depth test, separate front/back state, a stencil-masked window with outline and an even-odd fill; the stencil value is measured with 255 EQUAL-test draws and checked against a CPU model.
spec: ES 3.0 §3.6.1 Basic Polygon Rasterization (front/back facing, FrontFace, edge rule)
ES 3.0 §4.1.5 Depth Buffer Test (stencil update on depth fail / pass)
ES 3.0 §4.2.2 Fine Control of Buffer Updates (StencilMask, StencilMaskSeparate, clears use the front mask)
ES 3.0 §4.2.3 Clearing the Buffers (ClearStencil; clears obey the write mask, not the stencil test)
ES 3.0 §4.3.2 Reading Pixels (only color is readable: stencil is measured through colors)
ES 3.0 §4.4.5 Effects of Framebuffer State on Framebuffer Dependent Values (STENCIL_BITS)
GLSL ES 3.00 §7.1 Vertex Shader Special Variables (gl_VertexID, gl_PointSize)
GLSL ES 3.00 §7.2 Fragment Shader Special Variables (gl_FragCoord)

api.glEnable: STENCIL_TEST on/off decides whether the stencil test and updates apply (panel D, window, star); DEPTH_TEST for the sfail/dpfail/dppass cases; SCISSOR_TEST confines every cell and panel
api.glDisable: disabled stencil test leaves the stored value untouched even with REPLACE set (panel D); disabled depth test counts as passed
api.glIsEnabled: STENCIL_TEST: FALSE initially, TRUE after glEnable, FALSE after glDisable
api.glStencilFunc: all 8 functions x 7 reference/mask/clamp cases (56 cells) and the 255 EQUAL readout draws against a CPU model; GL_STENCIL_FUNC/REF/VALUE_MASK and BACK_* round trip for all 8, ref clamping on query; also sets the back face (clockwise triangle cell)
api.glStencilFuncSeparate: FRONT, BACK and FRONT_AND_BACK: front EQUAL 100 passes while back EQUAL 7 fails on the same pixel; queries show only the named face changes
api.glStencilOp: all 8 operations from start values 0, 1, 0x55, 254, 255 (40 cells, incl. INCR/DECR saturation and INCR_WRAP/DECR_WRAP wrap); sfail/dpfail/dppass slots distinguished (panel D); INVERT/REPLACE in the star and window; GL_STENCIL_FAIL/PASS_DEPTH_FAIL/PASS_DEPTH_PASS round trip
api.glStencilOpSeparate: front INCR vs back DECR on CCW/CW triangles (also with glFrontFace(CW) and a point); queries show only the named face changes
api.glStencilMask: only masked bits change (REPLACE, INVERT, ZERO, INCR carry, DECR borrow, mask 0); also applied to glClear; GL_STENCIL_WRITEMASK and BACK_WRITEMASK queried
api.glStencilMaskSeparate: front 0x0F / back 0xF0 REPLACE on CCW / CW triangles; glClear uses the front mask; queries show independent masks and FRONT_AND_BACK
api.glClearStencil: start values of all cells (0..255) and masked clears observed through the readout; GL_STENCIL_CLEAR_VALUE queried
api.glClear: COLOR|DEPTH|STENCIL per cell; stencil-only clears with write masks (the stencil test, set to NEVER, does not apply to clears); scissored
api.glClearDepthf: depth 0.5 in every cell decides dpfail vs dppass in panel D
api.glClearColor: cell base color equals the readout color for value 0, so cells holding 0 are distinguishable from the black grid
api.glColorMask: all channels FALSE during stencil-only draws: cell colors and the star's hole are left unpainted
api.glDepthMask: FALSE: depth not stored by a passing fragment while the stencil update still happens (panel D)
api.glFrontFace: CW swaps which triangle winding uses the front stencil state (panel E)
api.glViewport: per-cell and per-panel viewports map the full-viewport triangle onto the probed pixels
api.glScissor: confines each cell's clear and draws, the readout to the lab band, and each visual panel
api.glGetUniformLocation: uniform locations of the five programs (-1 for uniforms a program does not have)
api.glUniform1i: u_flip selects CCW or CW winding of the cover triangle
api.glUniform1f: u_depth (NDC z of the cover triangle), u_point_size, u_period (stripe period)
api.glUniform2f: u_center places the point on the probe pixel
api.glUniform3f: u_circle and u_star center/radius of the window disc and the pentagram
api.glUniform4f: readout color (v/255, 0.4, 0.4) per stencil value; stripe colors
api.glUseProgram: five programs (cover, stripes, point, circle, star) rendered the probed pixels
api.glDrawArrays: TRIANGLES (cover triangle), POINTS (point uses front state), TRIANGLE_FAN (disc, pentagram)
api.glReadPixels: RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE readback of the 145 probe pixels (via Check::expect_pixel)

visual_review.notes: 256x256 radeonsi capture: top ~116 px is a black-gridded heat map of 16x14 px cells (teal = stencil 0 through salmon = 255) in the layout described in the README: 8x5 operations table top left, 8x7 functions table top right, masks and sfail/dpfail/dppass rows below the operations table, 13-cell front/back row underneath. Bottom left: circular window with warm orange stripes inside a white outline ring over blue diagonal stripes; bottom right: five-pointed gold-striped star with a hollow pentagon in the middle on a dark gray panel (even-odd INVERT fill). Edges clean, no stray stencil artifacts outside the panels.
